title: Micaiah Prophesies and Ahab Dies

questions.question: Who did Ahab ask to join him in battle against Ramoth-gilead?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 22:4 (ESV): "And he said to Jehoshaphat, 'Will you go with me to battle at Ramoth-gilead?'"

questions.question: What did the 400 prophets tell Ahab?
options: Go up, for the Lord will give it into the hand of the king
questions.correctAnswer: Go up, for the Lord will give it into the hand of the king
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 22:6 (ESV): "...And they said, 'Go up, for the Lord will give it into the hand of the king.'"

questions.question: Who was the one prophet who did not prophesy good for Ahab?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 22:8 (ESV): "...Micaiah the son of Imlah, but I hate him, for he never prophesies good concerning me, but evil."

questions.question: What did Micaiah eventually prophesy?
options: I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd
questions.correctAnswer: I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 22:17 (ESV): "And he said, 'I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd...'"

questions.question: How did Ahab die?
options: A certain man drew his bow at random and struck the king
questions.correctAnswer: A certain man drew his bow at random and struck the king
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 22:34 (ESV): "But a certain man drew his bow at random and struck the king of Israel between the scale armor and the breastplate..."

questions.question: What vision did Micaiah see regarding the prophets?
options: A lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets
questions.correctAnswer: A lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 22:22-23 (ESV): "...I will go out, and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets..."

questions.question: Who struck Micaiah on the cheek?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 22:24 (ESV): "Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near and struck Micaiah on the cheek..."

questions.question: How did Ahab try to protect himself in battle?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 22:30 (ESV): "...I will disguise myself and go into battle, but you wear your robes..."

questions.question: What happened to Ahab's chariot?
options: It was washed at the pool of Samaria, and dogs licked up his blood
questions.correctAnswer: It was washed at the pool of Samaria, and dogs licked up his blood
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 22:38 (ESV): "And they washed the chariot by the pool of Samaria, and the dogs licked up his blood..."

questions.question: Who reigned after Ahab associated with the ivory house?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 22:40 (ESV): "So Ahab slept with his fathers, and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place."

questions.question: Who reigned in Judah during Ahab's time?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 22:41 (ESV): "Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab..."

questions.question: What did Zedekiah make for himself to demonstrate his prophecy?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 22:11 (ESV): "And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made for himself horns of iron and said..."

questions.question: What command did the king of Syria give his captains?
options: Fight with neither small nor great, but only with the king of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: Fight with neither small nor great, but only with the king of Israel
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 22:31 (ESV): "...Fight with neither small nor great, but only with the king of Israel."

questions.question: Why did the ships of Jehoshaphat not go to Ophir?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 22:48 (ESV): "...But they did not go, for the ships were wrecked at Ezion-geber."

questions.question: Where was Micaiah to be taken until Ahab returned?
options: To Amon the governor of the city and to Joash the king's son
questions.correctAnswer: To Amon the governor of the city and to Joash the king's son
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 22:26 (ESV): "...Take Micaiah, and return him to Amon the governor of the city and to Joash the king's son"

key_verse_text: And Micaiah said, “As the LORD lives, what the LORD says to me, that I will speak.” (ESV)
